geography.41: Collected Gyeonggi 36 current districts; income is province-level

price: Complete-complex household mean of all finite positive native model prices; current measured stock weights; known pre-construction excluded; confidence disclosed, not filtered
income: KB HOI regional household monthly income in KRW ten-thousand; annualized by multiplying by 12; native quarter-end observation labels
break_rule: 2019 HOI uses redesigned income survey. Separate 2010Q1–2018Q4 and 2019Q1–2026Q2; do not connect or compare across break
comparison: Indices independently start at 100 in each regime. Not official KB PIR, actual median-household burden, saving years or repayment years
cpi: Retained national all-items CPI, 2020=100; income and CPI are separate denominators
precision: Price: 0.1 KRW hundred-million; multiples/indices/changes: 0.1; shares: whole percent; official source income/CPI: 0.01. Independently rounded
limitations: Current measured stock is not historical inventory
Unknown-area stock is outside coverage denominator
Source quality caution remains material; not individual realized prices
Quarterly income seasonality is not adjusted
Regional income estimation details are not identified by retained schema
2010 reuses native model prices; 2011 onward complex-level overlap reconciled
